verdict.rationale: Copilot's marketing page describes a desktop workspace where you can track multiple agents, review changes, and merge work. The docs also describe a centralized control page for jumping between agent sessions. Both come from a single thin marketing line plus one docs line, with no detail on visual diff rendering or true side-by-side session layout. missing for 10: explicit visual diff viewer documentation, evidence of simultaneous side-by-side session display (vs. switching between sessions), in-depth desktop app docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can review diffs visually and run multiple sessions side by side in a desktop app

citations.quote: Launch work from GitHub, track progress across multiple agents, review changes, and merge completed work—all from one desktop workspace built natively on GitHub.
Use one centralized control page to jump between agent sessions, check progress, and stay in control without losing your place.
